fix(ci): bootstrap debug keystore on clean runners (#301)

GitHub-hosted runners do not have a debug keystore pre-created at
$HOME/.android/debug.keystore. The fork/PR fallback build step was
failing because AGP looks for this file when no signing config is
provided and exits with a keystore-not-found error before Gradle
even starts compiling.

Fix: generate a standard Android debug keystore via keytool before
invoking the Gradle build. Uses the canonical Android debug defaults
(alias: androiddebugkey, store/key pass: android) so the debug APK
is signed identically to a local developer build.

Secrets remain step-scoped (not job-level) so KEYSTORE_BASE64 and
other release credentials are not exposed to PR branch code.

fix(db): prevent SQLite duplicate isLocal column crash on startup (#302)

Fixes #297

Root cause:
  Some users upgrade to v1.2.4 via older fork/build paths where the
  'isLocal' column was already present on the 'song', 'artist', and/or
  'playlist' tables (introduced at schema v15/v16 and retained through
  various migration paths). A subsequent migration that blindly attempts:

    ALTER TABLE `song` ADD COLUMN `isLocal` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

  crashes deterministically with:

    SQLiteException: duplicate column name: isLocal (code 1 SQLITE_ERROR)

  This crashes Room's SQLiteOpenHelper.onUpgrade(), which prevents the
  database from opening at all — making the app unlaunchable for affected
  users.

Fix:
  Add MIGRATION_44_45 which uses the existing hasColumn() helper to check
  for 'isLocal' on 'song', 'artist', and 'playlist' before issuing any
  ALTER TABLE. This migration is a strict no-op for healthy databases and
  a targeted recovery for affected ones.

  Database version bumped 44 → 45.
  Schema export for v45 added (schema structure is unchanged from v44;
  only the version identifier is incremented).

feat(export): show export progress and fix stale state after backup restore (#303)

Fixes #287

This commit resolves two issues with the audio export system:

1. Added live progress reporting for exporting songs:
- Created `ExportProgressKey` to track per-song export completion.
- Updated `AudioExportService` to report download percentage during the stream byte transfer.
- Updated `SongMenu` to dynamically parse and display the percentage alongside the loading spinner (e.g. "Exporting • 45%").

2. Fixed stale export state appearing after a database backup is restored:
- Previously, restoring a backup brought over old `ExportedSongIdsKey` and `ExportingSongIdsKey` preferences, making the app falsely claim songs were exported when the physical MP3 files didn't exist on the new device.
- Added a one-time `clear_export_state` marker upon backup restoration in `BackupRestoreViewModel`.
- `MainActivity` detects this marker at boot and wipes all export-related tracking keys, ensuring a clean slate for the newly restored device.

fix(queue): keep playback start index in sync after explicit/video filtering

Queue.Status.filterExplicit/filterVideoSongs removed items from the
queue but left mediaItemIndex as a raw position, so any filtered-out
item ahead of the tapped song shifted playback onto the wrong track
(fixes #293). Re-locate the originally selected item by mediaId after
filtering instead of trusting the old index.

fix(playback): expose like/shuffle/repeat/radio commands to all controllers

PR #244 (Android Auto support) gated the custom session commands
behind an isAutomotive check (gearhead/gms.car/systemui), so the
regular system notification and mini player lost their shuffle and
repeat buttons (fixes #311). These commands back the only UI the
notification has for toggling shuffle/repeat/like/radio, so restrict
nothing and advertise them to every connecting controller again.

fix(db): apply renumbered positions when migrating legacy backup playlists

The old-schema-to-new-schema migration computed clean, sequential
per-playlist positions via .map { ... } but discarded the result and
inserted the songs with their original, non-sequential positions from
the old database instead. The drag-reorder SQL assumes contiguous
positions, so reordering silently did nothing on any playlist migrated
from an old backup (fixes #242).

fix(playback): authorize toggle commands instead of exposing them to any controller

Fixing the missing shuffle/repeat buttons (#311) by dropping the
isAutomotive gate left every controller able to invoke the like,
library, shuffle, repeat and start-radio custom commands. MusicService
is an exported MediaLibraryService, so any app on the device could
bind to the session and mutate this state without authorization
(CWE-862).

Replace the package-name allowlist with the actual Media3 trust APIs:
ControllerInfo.isTrusted (own app, systemui, MEDIA_CONTENT_CONTROL
holders, notification listeners), isMediaNotificationController,
isAutomotiveController and isAutoCompanionController. This keeps the
buttons working on the notification, Wear, and Android Auto while
rejecting an arbitrary unauthorized controller, and re-checks the same
authorization in onCustomCommand as defense in depth.

Addresses CodeRabbit review on PR #313.

fix(queue): match the selected occurrence when a queue has duplicate mediaIds

withFilteredItems re-pointed mediaItemIndex at the first surviving item
with a matching mediaId, so if the same song appeared more than once
in a queue and a later occurrence was the one selected, filtering
could snap playback back to an earlier occurrence instead.

Track which occurrence (by position among same-mediaId items) was
originally selected and locate that same occurrence in the filtered
list, falling back to -1 (and the existing clamp) when it didn't
survive filtering.

Addresses CodeRabbit review on PR #313.

Add StereoWidenerAudioProcessor for mid-side stereo widening

This commit introduces the StereoWidenerAudioProcessor class, which implements a mid-side stereo widening effect. The processor decomposes stereo audio into mid and side components, boosts the side component, and recombines them to create a wider stereo image without affecting the mono compatibility of the audio. The processor is designed to handle 16-bit PCM audio and passes through mono signals unchanged. The width of the effect can be adjusted between 1 (no widening) and 2 (maximum widening).

fix: address CodeRabbit review findings on PR #320

- Cross-check the claimed automotive/companion package name against its
  actual PackageManager UID before granting toggle-command access, since
  Media3 documents isAutomotiveController/isAutoCompanionController as
  non-authoritative string checks (authorization bypass).
- Add finite connect/read timeouts to the changelog network requests.
- Only mark a version's changelog "seen" after it's shown or dismissed,
  so a failed fetch retries on next launch instead of being lost.
- Rank exact artist-collaboration matches before partial ones, and drop
  substring matching to avoid short/generic-name false positives.
- Filter hidden songs inside the ranking subquery instead of after it,
  so they don't consume mostPlayedSongs' LIMIT slots.
- Preserve CancellationException instead of wrapping it during playlist/
  library pagination, so real coroutine cancellation still propagates.
- Include the recognition callback/label in FloatingTabBar's contentKey.
- Link-limit the stereo widener's output instead of clamping channels
  independently, avoiding asymmetric distortion on hard-panned peaks.

* fix(library): address CodeRabbit review findings on Bottom 50

- Fix the Top/Bottom AutoPlaylistButton layout in LibraryPlaylistsScreen: both were using Modifier.fillMaxWidth(0.5f).padding(end = 4.dp) instead of the FlowRow's itemModifier (Modifier.weight(1f)) used by every other button in the same row, which could overflow/misalign the row. Fixed in both list and grid layouts.
- Fix BottomPlaylistScreen's about section: it used R.string.about_album (wrong, copied from TopPlaylistScreen) instead of R.string.about_playlist, and hardcoded an English description string bypassing localization. Added a proper formatted string resource, bottom_playlist_description, with %1$s/%2$d args.
- Fix DatabaseDao.leastPlayedSongs and mostPlayedSongs: video-song exclusion was applied in Kotlin after the SQL LIMIT already capped the result set, so hiding video songs could return fewer than the requested count instead of backfilling with the next eligible song. Moved the hideVideoSongs condition into the inner subquery's WHERE clause (before GROUP BY/LIMIT) via a new hideVideoSongs query parameter, and removed the post-query .filter in both BottomPlaylistViewModel and TopPlaylistViewModel.
- Fix ordering: neither query had an ORDER BY on the outer SELECT, so the inner subquery correctly picked the top/bottom N songs by play time but the final row order wasn't guaranteed to reflect that ranking. Exposed the inner subquery's SUM(playTime) as totalPlayTime and added a matching outer ORDER BY.

The mostPlayedSongs/TopPlaylistViewModel changes fix a pre-existing bug identical to the ones CodeRabbit flagged in the new Bottom 50 code (same query structure, same defect) — fixed alongside for consistency since Top 50 shipped with the same underlying issue. All other mostPlayedSongs call sites (HomeViewModel, StatsViewModel, PlaylistWidgetManager) are unaffected: hideVideoSongs defaults to false, preserving their existing behavior, and they get the ordering fix for free.

Addresses CodeRabbit review comments on PR #420.

Fix: Prevent locally added playlist songs from vanishing after sync

Bug: When a user added a song to a YouTube-linked playlist, it would
briefly appear then disappear. The root cause was a race condition in
executeSyncPlaylist() — the sync would fire immediately on screen open,
fetch the remote playlist from YouTube (which doesn't have the new song
yet), call clearPlaylist() to wipe all local songs, then re-insert only
the remote songs — silently deleting any freshly added local songs.

There was also a secondary issue where a transient empty response from
the YouTube API would cause clearPlaylist() to nuke the entire playlist.

Fix:
- If remote returns empty, skip the clear entirely to protect against
  transient API failures and prevent data loss.
- If local has songs that remote doesn't (i.e. user just added songs
  locally that haven't propagated to YouTube yet), perform an
  additive-only sync: insert remote songs missing from local, but
  never delete songs that exist locally but not remotely.
- Only perform the destructive clear+replace when remote is fully
  authoritative (all local songs are also present in remote).

feat: integrate InnerTubeX stream resolution and supercharge playback performance

- Integrated InnerTubeX (https://github.com/MetrolistGroup/innertubex) for reliable streaming, bypassing age-restrictions and BotGuard blocks.
- Added pre-warming for InnerTubeX components and PoToken generation 2 seconds after app launch.
- Implemented robust 403 HTTP error recovery by notifying InnerTubeX of refusals, allowing fallback across various YouTube clients.
- Switched to ChunkedDataSource with dynamic chunk sizes (512KB - 1MB), significantly improving stream pacing and network reliability.
- Introduced DynamicLruCacheEvictor to protect the first 4MB of every cached track from eviction, ensuring immediate zero-latency starts on replay.
- Removed 2MB read-ahead caps and implemented full-track disk prefetching with an 8-second grace period to guarantee stutter-free transitions.
- Applied client-specific header parsing per stream URL to prevent silent server-side throttling.
- Updated README.md to credit InnerTubeX and document the new playback features.
- Updated app icon settings subtitle text.
